gaps.lead: My salary is half the size of my brother's.
gaps.explanation: 'Half the size of' reversed becomes 'twice as much as'.

gaps.lead: 'I'm sorry I was so rude to your sister,' Maria said.
gaps.sentence: Maria apologised ___ so rude to my sister.
gaps.explanation: apologise for + -ing: apologised for being so rude.

gaps.lead: This is the best coffee I've ever tasted.
gaps.explanation: 'The best I've ever tasted' → 'never tasted better'.

gaps.lead: We couldn't go out because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'Couldn't go because of' → 'were prevented from going'.

gaps.lead: He had just got home when the power cut happened.
gaps.sentence: ___ home when the power cut happened.

gaps.lead: A long, dry summer caused the famine.
gaps.sentence: The famine ___ a long, dry summer.
gaps.explanation: A causes B = B results from A (note the direction).
